cohort: Women who gave birth in Ontario, Canada, between 2006/07 and 2017/18
finding: Despite Canadian guidelines no longer recommending routine elective cesarean birth for women who are virally suppressed and receiving cART since 2014, the overall proportion of cesarean births among women living with HIV remained stable and was higher than among women without HIV.
mod_finding: The proportion of primary cesarean births decreased between 2006 and 2010 and between 2014 and 2018, whereas the proportion of repeat cesarean births increased.
